thread:
Maria Chen: Heads up — MirrorLake just pushed back the POC signoff. CISO says we need a BYO-KMS attestation + concrete egress pricing before execs will greenlight the pilot. Can we triage?

Leo Ortiz: Noted. They've also asked for sustained 1200 req/s throughput on embeddings with <100ms p95. Our Dedicated numbers look close but need a config call.

Devon Park: For throughput we can propose a two-node reserved pool with batching tweaks. Will need to validate with infra bench; can do a quick load run tomorrow (cc @OpsBot to schedule).

Anya Kuznetsova: On BYO-KMS: MirrorLake requires a documented attestation and KMS key rotation policy aligned with their security questionnaire. I can draft the attestation but need product confirmation on supported KMS providers and key lifecycle.

Kate Morales: Pricing: legal is asking for an egress cap line-item and a short-term pilot discount for committed trial volume. Suggest we offer 3-week pilot: reduced egress rate, trial credit $25k, and a clause to convert to reserved capacity with a 60-day notice. Thoughts?

Maria Chen: Exec asked for an owner for the bridge call. We need an internal exec to join tomorrow EOD to unblock MirrorLake's CIO & CISO. Who can commit?

Leo Ortiz: I can lead presales on the technical bridge. Need @Anya to present attestation + @Devon to sign off on throughput commitment. Kate can handle the commercial commitment.

Anya Kuznetsova: I'll prepare the attestation doc and answer the security Qs. Can you put the specific Qs in a single doc? MirrorLake sent a 30Q spreadsheet yesterday — link: https://mirrorlake.share/reqs-30q (internal copy attached to the SFDC opp).

Devon Park: OpsBot — please run a quick perf test against the staging model with these params and post results: 
```
model: rwd-inf-embed-1
concurrency: 64
seq_len: 1024
duration: 600s
batching: adaptive
```

OpsBot: Perf test scheduled for 2023-09-21 03:00 UTC. Will post results to #eng-runtime and link here.

Kate Morales: I'll draft the pilot SOW and include the egress cap + trial credit. Maria — want me to include an exec-level SLA escalation clause? Might help the CIO signoff.

Maria Chen: Yes please, add a 99.5% uptime target and a 4-hour exec escalation window during pilot. Also ask legal to pre-sign the PII/data-residency paragraph for EU processing.

Leo Ortiz: For the bridge: propose 9am PT tomorrow. I'll run the demo, Anya covers KMS, Devon covers perf, Kate covers SOW. Maria will you lead the customer intro?

Maria Chen: Confirmed. Send calendar invite to MirrorLake CIO, CISO, and our execs. Also drop a one-pager for them summarizing the pilot commitment (throughput numbers, BYO-KMS attestation timeline, egress pricing, trial credit).

Anya Kuznetsova: I'll attach the attestation template to the invite draft.

Devon Park: After perf run I'll post logs and a short summary: p50/p95/p99 + CPU/GPU utilization and mem. If numbers are off we can propose a temporary burst add-on for the pilot.

Kate Morales: Commercial note: if they convert to reserved Dedicated within 30 days post-pilot we can waive first-month commit. Will include that as an incentive.

Maria Chen: Great. Action items: Leo prep demo + invite (owner), Anya draft attestation (owner), Devon perf run + post results (owner), Kate SOW + pilot pricing (owner). OpsBot schedule confirmed.

Leo Ortiz: I'll post the calendar invite in 20 mins. Also tagging @Anya to confirm the KMS vendors list: AWS KMS, GCP KMS, Azure Key Vault — anything else we should call out?

Anya Kuznetsova: That's the list. For on-prem customers we can support HSM via partner integration — will note that in the attestation.

Maria Chen: Thanks team. If we get the attestation and perf numbers before the bridge we should be able to get CIO provisional signoff. I'll follow up in the invite thread. :thumbsup:
